arxiv-2101-01915.description: Abstract We report on the low-energy dynamics in the kagome antiferromagnet CaCu 3 (OD) 6 Cl 2 ⋅ 0.6 {}_{2}\cdot 0.6 D 2 O (Ca-kapellasite) as studied by use of 2 D-NMR measurements. Previous 35 Cl-NMR measurements revealed that the nuclear spin-lattice relaxation rate ( 1 / T 1 1/T_{1} ) shows two peaks at temperatures, T ∗ = 7.

arxiv-2110-10717.description: Abstract . When we deal with H ∞ H^{\infty} , it is known that c 0 − c_{0}- interpolating sequences are interpolating and it is sufficient to interpolate idempotents of ℓ ∞ \ell_{\infty} in order to interpolate the whole ℓ ∞ \ell_{\infty} .

arxiv-2210-00386.title: Fourier Transform Noise Spectroscopy
arxiv-2210-00386.creator: Arian Vezvaee, Nanako Shitara, Shuo Sun, Andrés Montoya-Castillo
arxiv-2210-00386.description: Abstract Spectral characterization of noise environments that lead to the decoherence of qubits is critical to developing robust quantum technologies. While dynamical decoupling offers one of the most successful approaches to characterize noise spectra, it necessitates applying large sequences of π \pi pulses that increase the complexity and cost of the method.

arxiv-2212-01646.title: Darboux transformation and soliton solutions of the generalized Sasa-Satsuma equation
arxiv-2212-01646.creator: Hong-Qian Sun, Zuo-Nong Zhu
arxiv-2212-01646.description: Abstract The Sasa-Satsuma equation, a higher-order nonlinear Schrödinger equation, is an important integrable equation, which displays the propagation of femtosecond pulses in optical fibers. In this paper, we investigate a generalized Sasa-Satsuma(gSS) equation. The Darboux transformation(DT) for the focusing and defocusing gSS equation is constructed.

arxiv-2307-12061.title: Torus shadow formalism and exact global conformal blocks
arxiv-2307-12061.creator: Konstantin Alkalaev and, Semyon Mandrygin
arxiv-2307-12061.description: Abstract Using the shadow formalism we find global conformal blocks of torus CFT 2 . It is shown that n n -point torus blocks in the “necklace” channel (a loop with n n legs) are expressed in terms of a hypergeometric-type function which we refer to as the necklace function.

arxiv-2307-15424.title: Deep Generative Models, Synthetic Tabular Data, and Differential Privacy: An Overview and Synthesis
arxiv-2307-15424.creator: Conor Hassan, Robert Salomone, Kerrie Mengersen
arxiv-2307-15424.description: A 2023 arXiv research paper by Conor Hassan, Robert Salomone, Kerrie Mengersen. This article provides a comprehensive synthesis of the recent developments in synthetic data generation via deep generative models, focusing on tabular datasets. We specifically outline the importance of synthetic data generation in the context of privacy-sensitive data. Additionally, we highlight the advantages of using deep generative models over other methods and provide a detailed explanation of the underlying concepts, including unsupervised learning, neural networks, and generative models.

arxiv-2407-13160.title: Droplet breakup and size distribution in an airstream - effect of inertia
arxiv-2407-13160.creator: Someshwar Sanjay Ade 1 , Pavan Kumar Kirar 2 , Lakshmana Dora Chandrala 3 and Kirti Chandra Sahu 2
arxiv-2407-13160.description: A 2024 arXiv research paper by Someshwar Sanjay Ade 1 , Pavan Kumar Kirar 2 , Lakshmana Dora Chandrala 3 and Kirti Chandra Sahu 2. We experimentally investigate the morphology and breakup of a droplet as it descends freely from a height and encounters an airstream. The size distributions of the child droplets are analysed using high-speed shadowgraphy and in-line holography techniques.

arxiv-2510-26473.title: Wireless Memory Approximation for Energy-efficient Task-specific IoT Data Retrieval Thanks: The work of J. Shiraishi was supported by European Union’s Horizon Europe research and innovation funding programme under Marie Skłodowska-Curie Action (MSCA) Postdoctoral Fellowship, “NEUTRINAI” with grant a
arxiv-2510-26473.creator: Junya Shiraishi, Shashi Raj Pandey, Israel Leyva-Mayorga, and Petar Popovski
arxiv-2510-26473.description: Abstract The use of Dynamic Random Access Memory (DRAM) for storing Machine Learning (ML) models plays a critical role in accelerating ML inference tasks in the next generation of communication systems. However, periodic refreshment of DRAM results in wasteful energy consumption during standby periods, which is significant for resource-constrained Internet of Things (IoT) devices.

arxiv-2511-17959.title: Towards Automating Data Access Permissions in AI Agents
arxiv-2511-17959.creator: Yuhao Wu 1 , Ke Yang 2 , Franziska Roesner 3 , Tadayoshi Kohno 4 , Ning Zhang 1 , Umar Iqbal 1
arxiv-2511-17959.description: Abstract As AI agents attempt to autonomously act on users’ behalf, they raise transparency and control issues. We argue that permission-based access control is indispensable in providing meaningful control to the users, but conventional permission models are inadequate for the automated agentic execution paradigm. We therefore propose automated permission management for AI agents .

arxiv-2601-20162.title: Me-Agent: A Personalized Mobile Agent with Two-Level User Habit Learning for Enhanced Interaction
arxiv-2601-20162.creator: Shuoxin Wang, ChangLiu, Gowen Loo, Lifan Zheng, Kaiwen Wei, Yinyi Zeng, Jingyuan Zhang, Yu Tian
arxiv-2601-20162.description: Abstract Large Language Model (LLM)-based mobile agents have made significant performance advancements. However, these agents often follow explicit user instructions while overlooking personalized needs, leading to significant limitations for real users, particularly without personalized context: (1) inability to interpret ambiguous instructions, (2) lack of learning from user interaction history, and (3) failure to handle personalized instructions.

arxiv-2601-21110.title: Unseen but not Unknown: Using Dataset Concealment to Robustly Evaluate Speech Quality Estimation Models
arxiv-2601-21110.creator: Jaden Pieper, Stephen D. Voran
arxiv-2601-21110.description: Abstract We introduce Dataset Concealment (DSC), a rigorous new procedure for evaluating and interpreting objective speech quality estimation models. DSC quantifies and decomposes the performance gap between research results and real-world application requirements, while offering context and additional insights into model behavior and dataset characteristics.

pmc-11477744.title: Evaluation on Preparation and Performance of a Low-Carbon Alkali-Activated Recycled Concrete under Different Cementitious Material Systems
pmc-11477744.creator: Cheng Liu, Xinyan Wang, Yujiao Li, Qiuyi Li, Gongbing Yue
pmc-11477744.description: A green, low-carbon concrete is a top way to recycle waste in construction. This study uses industrial solid waste slag powder (S95) and fly ash (FA) as binders to completely replace cement. This study used recycled coarse aggregate (RCA) instead of natural coarse aggregate (NCA). This is to prepare alkali-activated recycled concrete (AARC) with different cementitious material systems.

pmc-11508312.title: Pre-Hydration and a Forced Diuresis Protocol for 18F-FDG PET/CT Yielded an Optimal Effect on Primary Pelvic Malignancies
pmc-11508312.creator: Yi-Chia Hsieh, Wei-Jen Yao, Nan-Tsing Chiu, Wen-Horng Yang, Ho-Shiang Huang
pmc-11508312.description: Background: Positron emission tomography (PET) with 18F-FDG is being used more frequently to evaluate primary pelvic tumors (PTs). However, a standardized hydration protocol is essential for an optimal diuretic effect and constant results. Methods: We reviewed 109 patients with PTs who had undergone 18F-FDG PET/CT examinations between November 2006 and April 2013.

pmc-12385350.title: A Retrospective Study on the Association of the Systemic Inflammatory Response Index in Predicting the Severity of Obstructive Sleep Apnea
pmc-12385350.creator: Shamnaz Shahul, Sindaghatta Krishnarao Chaya, Sana Khader Mathamveed, Komarla Sundararaja Lokesh, Suhail Azam Khan, Aishwarya R Aladakatti, Venkatesh Kumar, Vivek Vasanthan, Jayaraj Biligere Siddaiah, Padukudru Anand Mahesh, Ludmilla Morozova-Roche
pmc-12385350.description: Background/Objectives: Obstructive sleep apnea (OSA) is a common disorder characterized by intermittent hypoxia and sleep fragmentation, assessed using the Apnea–Hypopnea Index (AHI). Systemic inflammation is central to OSA progression, and the systemic inflammatory response index (SIRI) has emerged as a potential biomarker for inflammatory diseases. This study investigates the relationship between SIRI and OSA severity while comparing other inflammatory markers.

pmc-12839727.title: Air Entrapment in a Pacemaker Pocket in a Child
pmc-12839727.creator: Vitaliy V. Suvorov, Dmitri O. Ivanov
pmc-12839727.description: Highlights What are the main findings? Implantation of a pacemaker in children is associated with a risk of air entrapment in the pacemaker pocket.This complication increases the risk of pacemaker malfunction. What are the implications of the main findings? Pacemaker implantation in children should be serially followed by chest radiographs.

pmc-13079829.title: A gut microbiome-kidney-heart axis predictive of future cardiovascular diseases
pmc-13079829.creator: Kanta Chechi, Rima Chakaroun, Antonis Myridakis, Sofia K. Forslund-Startceva, Sebastien Fromentin, Trine Nielsen, Judith Aron-Wisneswky, Eugeni Belda, Edi Prifti, Pierre Bel Lassen, Gwen Falony, Sara Vieira-Silva, Julien Chilloux, Kazuhiro Sonomura, Lesley Hoyles, Laura Martinez-Gili, Francesco Pall
pmc-13079829.description: Cardiovascular diseases (CVD) remain a major global health challenge. Early markers of disease initiation and progression are urgently needed. We, and others, have previously shown changes in the gut microbiome in association with metabolic and CVD. Here, we demonstrate that gut microbiome-related changes can be detected in association with subclinical variations in heart and kidney function.

pmc-13092589.title: Transforming Duchenne muscular dystrophy therapy: The multifaceted role of extracellular vesicles and exosomes
pmc-13092589.creator: Fatemeh Farzi, Fatemeh Soltanmohammadi, Seyed Abolghasem Mohammadi, Nosratollah Zarghami, Effat Alizadeh
pmc-13092589.description: Duchenne muscular dystrophy (DMD) remains a devastating X chromosome‐linked disorder with restricted curative options. Additionally, the existing treatment approaches, such as growth-modulating agents, anti-inflammatory drugs, antisense oligonucleotides with exon-skipping capabilities, stop codon mutation suppressors, vector-mediated gene therapy, CRISPR/Cas9 gene editing, and exogenous cell transplantation, can delay disease progression but are not curative.

pmc-13285334.title: Prediction of Zonisamide Concentration in Pediatric Patients With Epilepsy: A Machine Learning Approach
pmc-13285334.creator: Li Fashuang, Ma Mingbiao, Li Na, Li Huiying, Ren Danyang, Tu Caixia, Li Linbo, Zhang Lilin
pmc-13285334.description: ObjectiveTo construct and validate prediction models for zonisamide (ZNS) concentration in pediatric patients with epilepsy based on 12 machine learning algorithms, to screen for the optimal algorithm, and to provide a scientific basis for the formulation of individualized ZNS dosing regimens in children.

pmc-13474659.title: RNA-Seq analysis reveals early defense activation and responses associated with resistance to Fusarium thapsinum stalk infection in sorghum
pmc-13474659.creator: Kinde Ketema, Ramasamy Perumal, Christopher R Little, Sandeep Marla, Sanzhen Liu, Diriba Chere, Yemane Girma Belaineh, Terry Felderhoff, P V Vara Prasad, Tesfaye Tesso
pmc-13474659.description: Fusarium stalk rot in sorghum is caused by Fusarium thapsinum and affects sorghum production globally. In this study, we investigated genome-wide transcriptional responses associated with resistance to sorghum stalk rot. Transcriptomes of two sorghum genotypes, a resistant (SC599) and a susceptible (BTx3042) genotype, were analyzed at 24 and 48 h post-inoculation (hpi) with F. thapsinum at flowering.

pmc-13565728.title: Systematic Approach for Compound Angus Populations Revealing Positional Candidate Genes and Improving Prediction Accuracy in Carcass Traits
pmc-13565728.creator: Yuanyuan Yu, Yujiao Fu, Jiahong Zhao, Shiyu Wu, Shikai Wang, Zemin Li, Li Liu, Fang Sun, Jincheng Zhong, Jiabo Wang, Daoliang Lan, Yixi Kangzhu
pmc-13565728.description: Simple SummaryBeef cattle production plays an important role in providing high-quality animal products, and improving economically valuable traits can help increase production efficiency and sustainability. However, the biological factors that influence important carcass characteristics are complex and are not fully understood.

pmc-13585700.title: Clinical and immunologic features of adult primary antibody deficiency according to IVIGRT exposure
pmc-13585700.creator: Jung-Eun Han, Hyun young Lee, Haeng Jun Kim, Yoo Seob Shin, Yeong-Min Ye, Hae-Sim Park
pmc-13585700.description: Background/AimsPrimary antibody deficiency (PAD) in adults is increasingly recognized, but remains underdiagnosed and undertreated. We described the clinical and immunologic features of adult patients with PAD according to real-world exposure to intravenous immunoglobulin replacement therapy (IVIGRT) and explored whether the Ajou-PAD score reflects treatment decisions in routine clinical practice.
